payout_quote: The person making the referral (Referrer) will earn a $50 reward bonus for each individual referred (Referred Person) to Mainstreet Credit Union who registers for the offer, becomes a new member, opens a new Mainstreet Credit Union account, and completes the offer requirements within the time specified in the offer.
steps: Register for the Refer-A-Friend program via ReferLive on mainstreetcu.org.
Share your referral link/code with friends, family, or coworkers.
Friend registers, becomes a new Mainstreet CU member, opens a qualifying account, and completes the offer requirements within 60 days.
catches: Referred friend must be a new member and complete offer requirements (e.g., checking: enroll in eStatements + 25 debit purchases in 60 days) — no payout if they don't qualify.
Cap: $400 in total referral bonuses per calendar year, combined as referrer and/or referred person.
Bonus paid into primary savings within 30 days after qualifications met; referrer must be a member in good standing at referral and payout time.
Bonuses may be reported to the IRS as income; recipient responsible for tax liability.
Offer may be changed or discontinued at any time without notice; Kansas/Missouri branch membership eligibility applies.
biggest_catch: You only earn if the referred friend actually qualifies — new member + completes the offer requirements (e.g., 25 debit purchases in 60 days for checking).
eligibility: Current Mainstreet Credit Union member in good standing; referred person must be a new member. Employees, immediate family, board, and volunteers excluded.
timing: Register and share in ~10 minutes; bonus deposited into primary savings within 30 days after the referred friend meets all qualifications.
